b: It might actually be too late for me, my brain is cooked. I'll sit down to get work done and end up in scrolling for an hour when I have so much stuff to do.

And I'll start scrolling for the stupidest reasons too.
Microsoft Authenticator notification? Scrolling.
Waiting for ChatGPT response? Scrolling.
Going to the bathroom? Scrolling.
I've literally started to piss sitting down just so I can scroll.
I work from home FYI, and I've noticed myself working later and later just to finish stuff I should have gotten done during the day.
I've tried 10 different screen time apps at this point and I just end up ignoring the limits or deleting the app. Probably the same reason I always push my alarm every morning.

Has anyone actually managed to get their screen time under control? Like what worked for you? Was it an app or did you have to do something else? I'm genuinely curious because idk what to do at this point?
